What We'll Ask You

Who was hurt and by whom?
Basic details about the victim and perpetrator
What happened?
Your account in your own words
Where and when?
Locations, dates, and timeframes
Any evidence or witnesses?
Documents, photos, or people who can support your account

Time to Complete

8

Simple steps

About 30 questions total

Usually takes 30-45 minutes

You can write your answers somewhere else and add them in one go

Prepare Your Submission

  • Write key details in a private document first - dates, names, locations
  • Gather any supporting documents, photos, or evidence safely
  • Choose a time when you won't be interrupted or rushed

Digital Safety

  • Use a private computer or device if possible - not a work one
  • Clear your browsing history afterwards if needed
  • Consider using private browsing mode for extra privacy

You did nothing wrong. Your voice deserves to be heard. Justice delayed is not justice denied.
